title: Vocabulary: Health & Sport
objective: Words for the body, feeling well, and sport — frequent in Listening Parts 1–2.

items.meaning: a sign of illness (pain, cough, etc.)
items.example: The main symptom is a high temperature.

items.meaning: something you take to treat illness
items.example: Take this medicine twice a day.

items.meaning: an arranged time to see someone (doctor, dentist)
items.example: I have a dentist's appointment at 3 p.m.

items.meaning: in good condition; good for your health

items.example: A good diet includes plenty of vegetables.
items.exampleZh: 好的饮食包括大量蔬菜。

items.meaning: to get better after illness or injury
items.example: It took her a month to recover from the flu.
items.exampleZh: 她花了一个月才从流感中康复。

items.meaning: to hurt yourself or damage part of your body
items.example: He injured his knee playing football.

items.meaning: healthy and strong, especially from exercise
items.example: Swimming is a great way to keep fit.
items.exampleZh: 游泳是保持健康的好方法。

items.meaning: the unpleasant feeling when part of your body hurts
items.example: I have a sharp pain in my back.

items.meaning: to start a new sport or hobby
items.example: She took up running last spring.

keyPoints: Learn each word with its example sentence — context is what PET tests.
Say the word aloud, then use it in your own sentence about your life.
Review these words in the flashcard system until they reach mastered.
